snippet.title: The Lord of the Rings: Return to Moria™ - Durin's Folk: Release Date Announcement
snippet.description:
Happy Durin’s Day!

Free Range Games and North Beach Games are excited to announce that the upcoming expansion for The Lord of the Rings: Return to Moria will be released on November 18, 2025!

With the addition of NPCs, Traders, Expeditions and more on the way, it’s never been a better time to Return to Moria! 

#DragAFriendToMoria and #GetToTheGate to in preparation for welcoming new Dwarves into the mountain.

Wishlist now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3874660?utm_source=youtube&utm_campaign=durinsday&utm_content=announcement

Learn more about Durin’s Folk on our website: 
www.ReturntoMoria.com 

And join our Discord to keep up to date on all the latest from the Devs about the Expansion! 
https://discord.gg/6TNP7as9md 

----- 

The Lord of the Rings: Return to Moria, the only survival crafting game set in the Fourth Age of Middle-earth™, the iconic fantasy world created by J.R.R. Tolkien. 

Epic Games Store: https://store.epicgames.com/en-US/p/the-lord-of-the-rings-return-to-moria-f01344  
PlayStation: https://store.playstation.com/concept/10008445/  
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2933130?utm_source=youtube&utm_content=DFannouncement 
Xbox Store: https://www.google.com/search?client=firefox-b-d&q=xbox+returntomoria 

Find out more at www.ReturnToMoria.com
#lordoftherings  #freerangegames  #returntomoria  #durinsfolk
